productTitle.description: Name of the launched product or startup

tagline.description: Short official one-liner pitch from Product Hunt

makerName.description: Name of the maker, founder, or hunter who posted the launch

productHuntUrl.description: Official Product Hunt product page URL

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the product was posted on Product Hunt

websiteUrl.description: Direct external website URL of the startup

emails.description: Discovered business contact emails on the startup's website

phoneNumbers.description: Discovered phone or WhatsApp contact numbers

socials.description: Discovered social links (Twitter/X, GitHub, Discord, LinkedIn)

installedPixels.description: Marketing and analytics pixels detected (Meta Pixel, Google Analytics/GTM, TikTok Pixel)

missingPixels.description: Critical growth marketing pixels not detected on the website

startupLeadScore.description: Opportunity score (0-100) indicating sales outreach readiness
